title: fluxqc: Detection limits, quality screens and ebullition for chamber flux measurements, on top of goFlux
description: An R package extending goFlux (Rheault et al. 2024) for chamber flux measurements on any surface (soil, water, stems, leaves; diffusive or ebullitive): stacked CO2/CH4 window selection, non-interactive window detection, empirical per-measurement precision (Allan deviation of first differences, robust MAD variant), minimum detectable flux by several published methods with detection flags, a chamber-contamination screen, a ggplot2-compatible PDF exporter, analyzer clock-reset handling, ebullition detection and partitioning, and import helpers for very large LI-7810 files.
